title.text: What if this test passed every check?

lines.l01: Every frame starts from its own timestamp.
lines.l02: Now the probe reaches the ground.
lines.l03: A whip turn blurs only the scene.
lines.l04: The text above it stays perfectly sharp.
lines.l06: Seen from above, the wave keeps growing.
lines.l08: A white flash marks the next chapter.
lines.l10: Debris follows a fixed random seed.
lines.l12: Close up, every edge stays clean.
lines.l13: Then the whole city starts to rise.
lines.l14: A second wave rolls over everything.
lines.l15: And the probe lifts off again.
lines.l16: Every check passed. This was only a test.
